source_caption:
The seaside town in Luca was inspired by director Enrico Casarosa’s childhood summers on the Italian Riviera, especially the small villages of Liguria. He based the friendship between Luca and Alberto on his own childhood best friend, turning the film into a personal story about shyness, adventure, and the people who help us become braver.

Luca (2021), directed by Enrico Casarosa, starring Jacob Tremblay, Jack Dylan Grazer, Emma Berman. A warm and colorful Pixar coming-of-age story about friendship, identity, and self-discovery, following two sea monsters who dream of freedom in a sun-soaked Italian town.

source_details.synopsis: Luca is a 2021 American animated fantasy comedy film directed by Enrico Casarosa and written by Jesse Andrews and Mike Jones from a story developed by Casarosa, Andrews, and Simon Stephenson.
